profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: I have a passion for coding and automation that keeps me going. I enjoy solving problems and creating solutions.

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description: In this position I help manage production, staging, and dev servers for our SaaS products; participate in an on-call rotation to resolve outages, conduct maintenance, and perform software releases; automate processes; work with dev team and customers to provide custom integrations to our platform; document workflows; and work as an escalation point and mentor for IT System Administrators.

positions.title: IT Administrator - Cisco Telephony Administrator
positions.description: I managed the day to day operations of our customer facing Cisco phone system. I managed licensing, conducted monthly patching, and scripted call flows using Cisco Contact Center Express (CCX) to meet the needs of our CS and Sales departments with added features and functionality.

positions.title: IT Helpdesk Technician
positions.description: Provided phone, chat, and deskside support to internal employees. Managed employee onboarding and offboarding in Active Directory; did minor scripting in powershell to automate processes; worked in a mixed environment of Windows, Mac OSX, and Linux machines; tracked work and projects with Jira tickets; and provided training to new employees.

positions.title: IT Contractor
positions.description: Responsible for upgrading desktops and laptops from Windows 7 to Windows 10, deploying them both locally and to remote offices.
